name: Jeremy Allaire
sec_insider_companies: Circle Internet Group, Inc. (CRCL) - Chairman and CEO
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Hurun Global (2026); SEC insider holdings (2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2019-2025)
forbes_bio: Jeremy Allaire is the cofounder and CEO of Circle, issuer of USDC, the second-largest stablecoin by market capitalization.
A serial entrepreneur, Allaire previously founded and took public two internet companies: Allaire Corp., which helped web developers build sites, and Brightcove, a pioneer in online video publishing.
He pivoted to crypto in 2012, driven by an interest in creating a more robust international monetary system after the 2008 financial crisis, and cofounded Circle with Sean Neville.
The company initially focused on bitcoin payments before launching USDC in 2018 in partnership with crypto exchange Coinbase.
He took Circle public in June 2025 in a high-profile IPO, the first ever for a stablecoin issuer.

name: Xiong Haitao

forbes_bio: XiongHaitao is a director of Shanghai-listed Kingfa Sci.and Tech, a plastics supplier.
The company entered the markets for medical and protective gloves during the global pandemic in 2020.
Xiong is the wife of Yuan Zhimin, who founded Kingfa in 1993.

name: Wee Wei Ling
forbes_bio: Wee Wei Ling is the eldest child of late patriarch Wee Cho Yaw, cofounder of United Overseas Bank, one of Singapore's largest banks.
She sits on the board of Kheng Leong, the family's commercial property development and investment outfit.
She is the executive director of asset, lifestyle and sustainable partnerships at Pan Pacific Hotels Group, the luxury hotel arm of the family's real estate heavyweight UOL Group.
She also manages Pan Pacific's lifestyle brands such as St. Gregory and Si Chuan Dou Hua.
She is a director of the family's philanthropic Wee Foundation.

name: Harshil Mathur
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Hurun Global (2024-2026); Hurun Global U40 (2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2021-2026)
forbes_bio: Harshil Mathur cofounded financial services firm Razorpay, which operates India's largest payment gateway by transaction volumes.
Marquee investors include Singapore sovereign fund GIC and U.S. private equity player TVC.
Razorpay was last valued at $7.5 billion after raising more than $700 million over multiple funding rounds.
It has acquired eight businesses to date including a payroll management outfit and a point-of-sale platform.
It caters to the startup space serving 113 of the top 125 unicorns in India
forbes_facts: He has a B.Tech from IIT Roorkee
While at IIT Roorkee, he co-founded SDSLabs along with Razopay cofounder Shashank Kumar to encourage innovation through coding and software development.

name: Huang Yi
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2011-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026); Hurun China (2010-2026)
forbes_bio: Huang Yi chairs Zhongsheng Group, one of China's largest national car dealerships.
Zhongsheng focuses on luxury and mid-to-high-end brands such as Mercedes-Benz, Lexus, Porsche and Land Rover.
Huang and Li Guoqiang, Zhongsheng's CEO, established Zhongsheng Group in 1998.
Huang received an undergraduate degree in economics from Xiamen University in 1983.

name: Rajat Agrawal
forbes_bio: Rajat Agrawal is the founder and managing director of Jaipur-based lead recycling and manufacturing company Gravita India
It undertakes lead, aluminium and plastic recycling in addition to manufacturing lead ingots, sheets and alloys.
Gravita has customers in 38 countries across Europe, Asia, Africa and the Middle East
It has  manufacturing and recycling plants in India, Africa and Sri Lanka.
Agrawal started it as a welding and surface coating company in 1992. His father Mahaveer Prasad Agrawal is chairman

name: Yasemin Zeynep Keyman
forbes_bio: Yasemin Zeynep Keyman is one of more than a dozen family members who hold shares in ENKA, one of Turkey's largest construction and energy companies.

ENKA, which was cofounded in 1957 by Sarik Tara and his brother-in-law, Sadi Gulcelik, is Turkey's leading private electricity producer and also operates in real estate, tourism, transport and trade (construction equipment and machinery).
In Moscow, ENKA owns a hotel, shopping malls and approximately 370,000 square meters of net rentable Class A office space.
Sadi Gulcelik died in a plane accident in Saudi Arabia in 1980, and Mehmet Sinan Tara took over in 1984 at age 26. His son Agah Mehmet Tara became CEO in 2012, at age 29.
forbes_facts: Over the last 20 years or so, ENKA has been the biggest builder of U.S. consular and embassy buildings.
These government projects can be found in locations ranging from Turkey, Algeria and Nepal to Equatorial Guinea, the Dominican Republic and the Netherlands.

name: Zhu Tao

forbes_bio: Zhu is co-founder and chief scientific officer of CanSino Biologics, a supplier of vaccine products.
Zhu is primarily responsible for leading vaccine research.
Zhu graduated from University of Pittsburgh with a doctoratein chemical engineering in 2003.
Zhu conducted postdoctoral research at Carnegie Mellon University till 2004.
